map.展开长度 = 中性层 + 折弯补偿: Unfolded length = neutral axis + bend compensation
map.💡 公式：外截退量 OSSB=(R+t)·tan(θ/2)；折弯允许量 BA=(: 💡 Formula: outside setback OSSB=(R+t)·tan(θ/2); bend allowance BA=(R+K·t)·π·θ/180; bend deduction BD=2·OSSB-BA; unfolded length L=A+B-BD
map.K 因子通常取 0.3~0.5，与材料和相对弯曲半径 R/t 有关: The K-factor is usually 0.3-0.5, depending on the material and the relative bend radius R/t
map.当 R/t < 0.5 时可能产生裂纹，应增大内圆角半径: When R/t < 0.5, cracks may occur; the inside bend radius should be increased
map.折弯角度 θ 为折弯补角（材料实际弯曲角度），90° 为最常见: The bend angle θ is the bend complementary angle (the actual bending angle of the material); 90° is the most common
map.翼缘长度 A、B 为从外边到切点的距离，留 0 可仅计算弯角参数: Flange lengths A and B are the distances from the outer edge to the tangent point; leaving them 0 computes only the bend parameters
map.实际展开应考虑回弹，通常折弯角度需过弯 1°~3°: Actual unfolding should account for springback; the bend angle usually needs 1°-3° of overbending

map.不同 K 因子（材料/工艺）对折扣除的影响。: The effect of different K-factors (material/process) on the bend deduction.
map.校验折弯扣除 BD 是否等于 2·OSSB−BA。: Verify whether the bend deduction BD equals 2·OSSB−BA.
map.同参数 K=0.5：BA=(2+1.0)·1.5708=4.712、BD=8−4: Same parameters with K=0.5: BA=(2+1.0)·1.5708=4.712, BD=8−4.712=3.288, L=100−3.288=96.712 mm. The larger the K, the further out the neutral axis and the longer the unfolded length.
map.中性层位置系数，K=中性层到内表面距离/板厚。软钢约 0.33–0.5，取决于材: It is the neutral-axis position coefficient: K = distance from the neutral axis to the inner surface / sheet thickness. For mild steel it is about 0.33-0.5, depending on the material, thickness, tooling and radius.
map.折弯扣除 BD=外侧拉伸补偿−内侧压缩，标准展开 L=各直段和−ΣBD；OSSB: The bend deduction BD = outer-tension compensation − inner compression; the standard unfolded length L = sum of straight segments − ΣBD. OSSB is the outside setback, and geometrically BD=2·OSSB−BA.
